fit_reason: Whole car, a 2001 Toyota Echo coupe listed by a private owner.
findings: Hazy, yellowed lens on the front headlight
Red paint looks somewhat flat and lacks depth on the hood and doors in the full-sun shots
Black lower bumper trim and side mirror look faded and grayish
Grime visible along the lower rear bumper
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Echo. In the photos the headlight lens looks a bit hazy and the black bumper trim is fading. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including headlight restoration and a buff and wax to bring back the shine on the red paint. Would you like a quote?
